[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Accepting a configured task type from the Capture panel's `#` menu [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]at the start of an empty new-task item also types that type's lead [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]accept, one Backspace or ⌘Z removes it, and accept-and-capture [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never mints a one-word task. The five leads (BUILD, FIX, PLAN, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]READ, WRITE) come from `capture.type_leads` in the chezmoi-managed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bob config.[/#D7D7AF]
